title: 5x-review-1: review lessons foundation (schema, LessonsDb, sutra_read injection)
description:
## Parent

sutra/150 — Code-anchored lessons: sutra_remember / contextual surfacing

## What to review

Foundation checkpoint. The shared lessons DB exists, `sutra_remember` can write lessons, `sutra_read` surfaces them for exact symbol matches.

**Reviewer focus:**
- DB schema design — are the tables right before everything else builds on them?
- LessonsDb interface — is the API clean for the matching/lifecycle/query work coming next?
- Response format in sutra_read — is the lesson JSON shape right for agents to consume?
- Migration system — is it properly independent of per-workspace migrations?

**vidhi-sutra-tend moment:** The LessonsDb module internals exist for the first time. Good time to constrain while small — run vidhi-sutra-tend to lock down naming, visibility, and structural conventions before the next wave adds matching, lifecycle, and enrichment.

## Blocked by

- sutra/151 — Lessons store + sutra_remember + sutra_read injection
execution_record: Codex adversarial review surfaced 4 findings. Fixed 2 in-wave: (1) source_task_ids were accepted by StoreLessonParams but never written to the citations table — added INSERT loop in store(); (2) unknown anchor kinds silently coerced to Symbol — now returns InvalidArgument. Deferred 2 to later waves: short-name vs qualified-name matching (→ sutra/153 comment), project_origin scoping in query_for_context (→ sutra/168).
